newsitem.title: USA: Great Western sets March 13 record date.
newsitem.headline: Great Western sets March 13 record date.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp said it set March 13 as the record date for the consent solicitation started by H.F. Ahmanson and Co.
Earlier, Ahmanson said it started a consent solicitation of Great Western shareholders to support its $6.2 billion bid for Great Western.

On Friday, the Delaware Chancery Court ruled Ahmanson could proceed with the consent solicitation. The ruling stemmed from a request by Great Western for a temporary restraining order against the consent solicitation. The court reserved its ability to rule on the merits of Great Western's request, pending the outcome of the consent solicitation.
